issue: Does 'loss' under U.S.S.G. § 2B1.1(b)(1) include intended loss, or is it limited to actual loss?

cases: United States v. Gadson, 77 F.4th 16 (1st Cir. 2023)
United States v. You, 74 F.4th 378 (6th Cir. 2023)
United States v. Lee, 77 F.4th 565 (7th Cir. 2023)
United States v. Verdeza, 69 F.4th 780 (11th Cir. 2023)
United States v. Tellez Crespo, 86 F.4th 1148 (6th Cir. 2023)

sides.position: 'Loss' under U.S.S.G. § 2B1.1(b)(1) is limited to actual loss.
cases: United States v. Banks, 55 F.4th 246 (3d Cir. 2022)

this_court: Follows the intended-loss view under binding Sixth Circuit precedent (United States v. You), while noting that the opposing reading may be correct and not deciding the question on the merits.
quote: The Third Circuit, we note, has held otherwise.
cite: United States v. Yanier Tellez Crespo, 86 F.4th 1148 (6th Cir. 2023)
